description: Starts watching a CNPJ. The first one is free; each extra slot is paid per 30 days, with no automatic renewal (the price is in `x-price-usd` and in `/api/pricing`). The service repeats the checks and detects changes, so the agent does not need to keep polling. Coverage follows the available sources and active slots. Read the monitoring and alert state.

cnpj.description: CNPJ to watch, without punctuation: 14 digits or the alphanumeric one.

credito.description: Global prepaid credit token (cred_…), issued by POST /api/credito.
